thread:
Alex: quick heads-up — sec scan found ~8 orphaned Vault AppRole entries under auth/approle/ci-legacy-*. Some roles still reference KMS‑wrapped transit keys and an old CI service account. We should do a coordinated cleanup + rekey. Prefer doing this in a maintenance window, EOD Wed (can be earlier if owners respond).

secbot: automated-scan: detected stale approles: auth/approle/ci-legacy-001..ci-legacy-008. Last used: 2024-11-26 by sa:ci-runner-old. Risk: medium — stale credentials + KMS key bindings. See /reports/secrets-scan/1759001234.

Priya: agree we should treat as a scoped incident. Two parts: 1) identify any live consumers, 2) rotate/rekey KMS keys + revoke roles. Do we have an owner list for those approles?

Alex: we have partial owners — a few map to old infra repos (infra/legacy-tests), others to a now-deleted repo. I ran a quick query (Vault audit logs) and saw token creation events from the old CI SA in March/April 2025.

Jamie: I can take the vault-side commands and run a dry-run in staging. Suggested playbook: 
- freeze roles (set token_ttl = 1m or create deny-policy)
- check active tokens bound to those roles `vault list auth/token/accessors` + `vault token lookup`
- revoke tokens for confirmed orphaned roles
- rewrap transit keys with new KMS key version
- delete role once confirmed no consumers

Alex: adding the quick commands I used in staging: 
```
# list approles matching pattern
vault list auth/approle/role | grep ci-legacy || true
# check role metadata
vault read auth/approle/role/ci-legacy-001
# look for active tokens referencing role (accessor -> lookup)
vault list auth/token/accessors | xargs -n1 vault token-lookup -format=json | jq 'select(.data.meta.role=="ci-legacy-001")'
```

Mike: re: KMS — some of those roles use transit keys that were wrapped by GCP KMS key ring `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/inference/cryptoKeys/vault-transit`. We should rekey before deleting roles to avoid leaving wrapped blobs un-decryptable in logs/backups. I can create a new key version and coordinate rewrap.

Priya: RBAC: Before we revoke, let's ensure no current production path uses them. @Jamie please run a quick cross-check: k8s secrets referencing Vault paths + CI pipeline configs that reference those approles. Use `rg "ci-legacy"` across repos and the vault path index. If anything returns, tag owner and pause deletion.

Jamie: will run. Planned checks: 
1) repo grep across infra + services (scan job will post results)
2) vault audit log query for last 12 months (sample query below)
```
# audit log query example (gcloud)
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=\"gce_instance\" AND protoPayload.request.@type=\"type.googleapis.com/google.cloud.vault.v1.AccessEvent\" AND textPayload:\"ci-legacy\"' --freshness=365d --format=json
```
I'll post findings in ~45m.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window proposed: Wed 2025-08-13 20:00-22:00 UTC. Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm.

Priya: sync plan if checks clear: 
- Weekday window 20:00-22:00 UTC (canary first: pick one approle + rewrap key + revoke tokens)
- Monitor auth failures for 30m, if no regression proceed with batch revoke+delete
- Record all actions in the incident ticket and add audit snapshots (pre/post)

Alex: for KMS rewrap (GCP) example flow Mike will run: 
```
# create new key version (gcloud)
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=wa-vault-transit --keyring=inference --location=global --project=redwood-prod
# rewrap wrapped payloads (example pseudocode)
wrapped = read_blob()
new_wrapped = gcloud kms encrypt --key=wa-vault-transit --location=global --keyring=inference --plaintext-file=<(gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=- --key=old-key)
```
Note: take backups of wrapped blobs and test decrypt with new key version in staging first.

Mike: I'll provision the new key version and give Jamie a short-lived service account with encrypt/decrypt perms for the rewrap run. No root privs. I will also export a list of wrapped blobs that reference the old key.

Alex: timeline check — Jamie will post scan results, Mike will create key version, I'll schedule the canary role and run revoke commands in staging first. Priya — can you sign off on go/no-go once Jamie posts?

Priya: yes, will review and sign off. If we see any active production hits we pause and open a mitigation (rotate consumer creds and migrate).

Jamie: scan done — grep found two CI jobs in infra/legacy-tests and one service `metrics-ingest` referencing `ci-legacy-002`. I tagged owners in the results and created a short task list in the ticket.

Alex: OK. Next actions: 
- Mike: create key version + list of wrapped blobs (ETA 2h)
- Jamie: create frozen-role patch in staging + list of active tokens (ETA 1h)
- Priya: standby for sign-off after Jamie posts

secbot: reminder: add vault/audit-log snapshots for pre/post operations and attach to ticket INC-2025-472.

Mike: key version created: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/inference/cryptoKeys/vault-transit/cryptoKeyVersions/3. Posted ARN in the ticket. Will coordinate rewrap at canary start.

Alex: thanks all. I'll run the canary revoke on ci-legacy-002 in staging at 20:05 UTC and report back. Please keep alerts on for any auth spikes. :eyes: 

Priya: ack. If anything weird shows up we rollback by re-creating the approle with the previous role_id and restoring tokens is next-resort (documented).

Alex: canary complete. No auth failures for metrics-ingest canary. Proceeding with batch revoke at 20:40 UTC.

Alex: batch revoke done, keys rewrapped, roles deleted for ci-legacy-001..008. Attached audit snapshots and rewrap verification to INC-2025-472.

Priya: thanks — closing as resolved after 24h observation window. Filing a follow-up to improve owner tagging for approles and add automated alert when a role has zero last-used > 180d.

Mike: noted, will add automated scan rule to alert channel.

Alex: great work everyone.
